notes: Failsafe for 'map gen failed' after an auto-update. The Map Hack needs write access to its D2 LoD folder; the installer granted that but the in-app updater did not, so anyone who auto-updated from an older build ended up with a read-only folder and an unreadable exit=1 error. The app now checks, repairs the permission and retries by itself - no console, no reinstall - and the updater grants it too so it cannot recur. Also included: Steam accounts can be automated again - keyboard input works on Steam-launched D2R and the game no longer crashes on Tab.
